fix(camellia): wrap long exam and artifact titles

Summary:
- render exam-library paper names with a wrapped table cell instead of the
  default truncated renderer
- widen and wrap the artifact association name column so long document titles
  remain readable next to their ids

Rationale:
- the shared DataTable defaults force nowrap ellipsis, which clipped both
  issue-reported title columns too aggressively
- scoping the override to these two columns fixes the display regression
  without changing other Camellia tables

Tests:
- just camellia check
